citations.text: H. Wang, L. Zhao, K. Yan, X. Wang, Y. Liang, J. Hao (2025). Meituan: Operational-level on-demand food delivery data for the 2025 INFORMS TSL Data-Driven Research Challenge.

description: Operational data from Meituan's on-demand food delivery platform for the 2025 INFORMS TSL Data-Driven Research Challenge, covering orders, couriers and merchants, with the waybill and wave records of how orders were dispatched.
name: Meituan-INFORMS-TSL research challenge dataset

recipe.reason: The data is released under CC BY-NC 4.0 with a bar on passing it to third parties without permission, and its coordinates are shifted by the publisher, so they are not WGS84 positions.
